key.name: adaptive-nature-mode
key.description: Controls the environment-aware theming behavior. 'static' — Fixed theme, no adaptation. 'adaptive' — Responds to time, weather, and battery (recommended). 'expressive' — More dramatic transitions and animations.

key.name: glass-opacity
key.description: Background opacity of glass surfaces (0.3 = very transparent, 0.95 = nearly opaque)

key.name: blur-sigma
key.description: Gaussian blur radius for glass effects. Higher values are more blurry but use more GPU resources.

key.name: blur-brightness
key.description: Brightness of the blurred background behind glass panels.

key.name: dock-autohide
key.description: Automatically hide the bottom dock when a window is maximized or fullscreen.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: Size of application icons in the bottom dock in pixels.

key.name: dock-show-resource-pulse
key.description: Display color-coded activity indicators on running app icons (blue=idle, orange=moderate, red=heavy).

key.name: live-center-show-media
key.description: Display currently playing media information (artist, track) in the Live Center.

key.name: live-center-show-in-focus
key.summary: Show Live Center in Focus State
key.description: Keep the Live Center visible when an application is maximized.

key.name: show-desktop-widgets
key.description: Display weather and greeting widgets on the desktop background.

key.name: weather-auto-location
key.description: Use GeoClue2 to automatically detect the user's location for weather data.

key.name: weather-latitude
key.description: Manual latitude for weather data (used when auto-location is disabled).

key.name: weather-longitude
key.description: Manual longitude for weather data (used when auto-location is disabled).

key.name: temperature-unit
key.description: 'celsius' or 'fahrenheit'

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: Controls animation intensity. 'reduced' — Minimal animations for accessibility or low-end hardware. 'normal' — Standard Beeta Motion™. 'expressive' — Richer, longer animations.

key.name: adaptive-motion-enabled
key.description: Automatically reduce animation intensity on battery, Power Saver mode, or older hardware.

key.name: live-wallpaper-enabled
key.description: Enable video/animated wallpaper support using GStreamer.

key.name: live-wallpaper-path
key.description: Absolute path to the video file to use as a live wallpaper.

key.name: live-wallpaper-mute
key.description: Mute the audio track of the live wallpaper video.

key.name: user-display-name
key.description: Name shown in greetings. Leave empty to use the system username.
